editor.label: World GUID
editor.description: The world to run: the part after ~ in its folder name in SaveData/Worlds. To host a world from your PC, upload its folder (AppData/LocalLow/Vector3 Studio/Sunkenland/Worlds/<name>~<GUID>) to SaveData/Worlds and enter its GUID here. A GUID without a world starts a new one.

editor.label: Region
editor.description: Players must pick the same region to see and join the server.

editor.label: Server password
editor.description: Up to 8 letters or digits, no spaces. Leave empty for a public server.

editor.label: Hide from the session list
editor.description: Players then join with the Server ID (shown in the query) or a Steam invite.

editor.label: Autosave interval (seconds)
editor.description: The server saves only while players are online. Stopping the server waits for the next save when players are online.

editor.label: Administrator Steam IDs
editor.description: SteamID64s separated by spaces. Administrators can kick, ban and save the game. More can be listed in AdminSteamIDs.txt of the world.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: The name in the session list (it is the name of the world folder). Do not use ~ / \ : * ? " < > |.

editor.label: Description
editor.description: Shown with the world in the game. No double quotes.

editor.label: Survival
editor.description: How fast hunger, thirst and health drop.

editor.label: Death penalties
editor.description: Players drop their items when they die.

editor.label: Shared flags
editor.description: Everyone can use the territory flags.

editor.label: Shared spawn points
editor.description: Everyone can respawn at the beds.

editor.label: Random spawn points
editor.description: New players start at a random place.

script.name: Prepare the world
script.description: Links the game save folder to SaveData, renames the world folder after a name change, copies Config/WorldSetting.json into it and starts a new world when the folder has no save yet (the server cannot create one).

script.name: Wait for the autosave
script.description: Before a stop: lets a save in progress finish and, with players online, waits for the next autosave (the server does not save when it is closed).

script.name: Sunkenland query
script.description: Online while the game port is bound and the log says the server started; reports the Server ID players join with and the player count.
